body:
This PR optimizes GPU memory access patterns in the remapping kernels to ensure coalesced reads and writes:

- **`remapping_distributed.jl`:** Reordered `CartesianIndices` iteration to ensure coalesced global memory reads.
- **`remapping_interpolate_array.jl`:** Replaced in-loop global memory accumulations with explicit thread-local register accumulation in `interpolate_slab_kernel!`. 

This currently makes no performance difference in benchmarks, apparently because the compiler already optimizes these patterns (e.g., hoisting the memory accumulations into a register automatically). But these changes guarantee coalesced memory traffic and protect performance in case future compiler heuristic changes or loop complexity increases.
title: Makes memory access patterns in remapping kernels more robust
